Context\\\", \\\"context\\\"),\\n        (\\\"2. Decision\\\", \\\"decision\\\"),\\n        (\\\"3. Consequences\\\", \\\"consequences\\\"),\\n        (\\\"2. Decision  \\\", \\\"decision\\\"),\\n    ];\\n    let mut ok = true;\\n    for (input, expected) in cases {\\n        let got = normalized(input);\\n        let pass = got == expected;\\n        ok &= pass;\\n        println!(\\\"{:?} -> {:?} (expected {:?}) {}\\\", input, got, expected, if pass {\\\"OK\\\"} else {\\\"FAIL\\\"});\\n    }\\n    assert!(normalized(\\\"Decision\\\") != normalized(\\\"2. Context\\\"), normalized(\\\"Context\\\"));\\n    println!(\\\"overall: {}\\\", if ok { \\\"PASS\\\" } else { \\\"FAIL\\\" });\\n}\\nEOF\\nrustc -O /tmp/test_strip.rs -o /tmp/test_strip 2>&1 | tail -30 && /tmp/test_strip\",\"description\":\"Standalone compile and run of strip_numbering logic to validate behavior\"}"
